stale_attempt_no_proposal: attempt 1 has crash_loop but attempt 2 is healthy, so there is no proposal.
duplicate_identical_records_collapse: identical records collapse to one current finding and one supporting ID.
ambiguous_finding_id_no_proposal: one ID on two different records, one carrying crash_loop, excludes the specialist.
same_attempt_conflicting_records_no_proposal: two distinct records at the same attempt, one carrying crash_loop, exclude the specialist.
ambiguity_is_not_salvaged: an ambiguous attempt 1 excludes the specialist even when a clean attempt 2 carries crash_loop.
approve_and_execute_once: a valid, bound approval executes exactly once, simulated, and the specialist does not run again.
reject_never_executes: a valid, bound rejection ends the incident without an execution.
approved_string_true: the string 'true' is not an approval.
approved_integer: the integer 1 is not an approval.
missing_decided_by: a decision with no decided_by is not an approval.
blank_decided_by: a blank decided_by is not an approval.
list_payload: a list is not an approval.
none_payload: a null decision never approves (how the graph reacts is not pinned, only that nothing changes).
missing_action_id: a decision that names no action is not an approval.
wrong_action_id: a decision naming another action is not an approval.
other_proposals_action_id: the real ID of a different proposal cannot approve this one.
bad_step_then_valid_step: after a rejected attempt nothing is approved without an explicit bound decision (the outcome of the second step is not pinned).
replay_after_completion: replaying a valid decision after the incident completed executes nothing a second time.
kubernetes_raises: a specialist exception becomes a failed finding, with no proposal and no pause.
missing_investigator: an unregistered specialist produces a blocked finding, not a crash or a proposal.
observability_raises_kubernetes_proposes: one failing specialist does not stop another, and the failed finding supports nothing.
